beamngEarth_devToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: toggle dev overlays
beamngEarth_devToggle.desc: Turns the last-used BeamNG.Earth dev tools preset on (default: LOD), or everything off. Unbound by default.

beamngEarth_reportNote.title: BeamNG.Earth: note / report
beamngEarth_reportNote.desc: Captures a screenshot, the location and the performance now, and opens a window for a note (Ctrl+Shift+N).

beamngEarth_reportBench.title: BeamNG.Earth: 30 s benchmark
beamngEarth_reportBench.desc: Records 30 s of frame times while you drive and saves a report (Ctrl+Shift+B).
